annual_probability.cite: 6 of the last 20 quarterly/annual earnings weeks (2021-2026) moved >=10% in magnitude (research/CRM/2026-10-08-mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks, types containing earnings_release/annual_report): -10.1%, +14.9%, +15.9%, -13.9%, +13.0%, +22.4%.
